event_chain.summary: Insider Flock ALPR searches for personal use

summary: Two Hall County (Georgia) Sheriff's Office investigators, Justin Brown and Michael Atkins, were fired after an internal Flock audit found they used the Flock license plate reader system for reasons unrelated to their jobs - Brown on at least two searches and Atkins on at least four occasions for personal use. Brown was referred to the Georgia Bureau of Investigation. The firings were announced August 25, 2026.
